nodes.hint_edit: A histology report is the usual basis for a soft tissue sarcoma code. Without one, only a few codes can be registered at all.

options.label_head: Referral letter or clinical note only — no imaging report, no cytology,
options.rationale: Lowest tier. The label excludes imaging, cytology and histology. A lone Lab Report, IHC Report or Gene report names none of those, so such sets fall here, which understates the file and is the safe direction. Together with options 1 to 3 every one of the 128 sets fits exactly one tier.

options.label_head: Ultrasound, CT or MRI report — no cytology or histology in the file
options.rationale: Needs the Imaging Report document and excludes the two higher tiers named in the label. Lab, IHC and genetics ticks beside imaging do not change the tier because the label asserts none of them.

options.label_head: Fine-needle aspiration or other cytology report only — no histology repo
options.rationale: Requires the Cytology document itself. IHC beside Cytology with no Histology Report stays here as immunocytochemistry, because the option wording names no cell block or tissue. Imaging may also be ticked, since the label says cytology only against histology, not against imaging; the higher evidence wins.

options.label_head: Histology report from a biopsy or a resection
options.rationale: Highest tier. Requires the Histology Report document, with no other restriction; the destination question (st_report_contents) asks what else the pathology file holds, so IHC and genetics ticks refine it there.

options.label_head: A specimen was taken but the report calls it inadequate, non-diagnostic
options.rationale: States the quality of a specimen, which no document id can express. It captures evidence_tests [] and basis_evidence_tier inadequate_specimen, and routes to st_imaging_report, which has its own 'No imaging report in the file' branch. Always available.

nodes.hint_was: Pick the highest tier of evidence genuinely in the file. A histology report is the usual basis for a soft tissue sarcoma code. Without one, only a few codes can be registered at all.
